review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: add bounded active-turn image delivery and truthful receipts
review.notes: Two exact screenshot receipts were accepted into target backend queue with image inputs but remained pending while a long turn continued. Existing overlay calls queued receipt received by terminal. Current installed schema provides metadata-only thread/read, turns/list itemsView=notLoaded/limit1 and steer expectedTurnId. Read-only live metadata is evidence only, not input acceptance. Restrict new path to already authorized uploads images; preserve text/HQ queue semantics and old Codex compatibility. Reuse verified existing backend, explicit home/thread/peer checks and durable claim. No resume, queue consumption/deletion/reordering, mutation of existing messages, interrupt or raw keys. Only explicit protocol unsupported can use queue; no replays after uncertain writes. Actual App/CLI runtime stays unchanged until separately authorized update. Unit/wire/native model checks do not prove live screenshot arrival. Post-implementation owner review: body text alone must not opt in to active delivery, because an HQ report can quote an existing upload path. Gate the new path on explicit CLI --attach intent as well as the recognized upload image; a quoted image path in ordinary/HQ input must retain the queue. Add that negative case within SSI-002. Also distinguish read-only input metadata failure from genuine pending confirmation in the Mac receipt interpreter; preserve refusal and editable draft, do not label a transport failure as a human decision. Case identities and original observable expectations are unchanged; this review note is committed before the strengthening regressions.

cases.description: Screenshot native transport chooses exact active turn without large history or unsafe fallback
cases.setup: Synthetic verified backend wire, home/thread metadata, notLoaded one-turn response, approval flags, older unsupported methods and dropped/malformed/rejected mutation receipts
cases.action: Run production image submission; inspect every RPC method, destination, user-message ID and native image entry
cases.expected: Active eligible thread uses turn/steer with exact expectedTurnId; no queue/start, interrupt, full-history read or duplicate accepted input. Only explicitly unsupported read/steer methods can fall back to original queue behavior; generic errors/uncertain write never replay. Waiting flags and target/home/peer mismatch refuse before input. Byte/deadline bounds remain.

cases.description: Real native dispatcher selects active image input and persists delivery identity at most once
cases.setup: Synthetic strict frontend binding, private synthetic PNG in fixture uploads, actual Prepare/ClaimNative/FinishNative and injected addressed RPC
cases.action: Submit image twice under same action ID; contrast text-only/unknown/unsupported/uncertain/changed binding/approval hold
cases.expected: Only existing authorized image inputs request active submission; ordinary text stays existing queue. Exact target and image survive, accepted mode persists, retry does not resubmit, uncertain never enters queue or alternate pane; receipt mode backward compatible.

cases.description: Mac screenshot feedback distinguishes active acceptance, queued follow-up and actual delivery
cases.setup: Actual ScreenshotSender.interpret, Overlay/StatusText and editor model, both languages; synthetic receipts only
cases.action: Interpret active/queued/landed/uncertain/conflicting nonzero exit and inspect visible/accessible title/detail/model state
cases.expected: Queued never claims terminal receipt; active acceptance says current task, never task completion. Nonzero/unrecognized receipt cannot falsely succeed; accepted receipts keep existing fast-close semantics and failure preserves editable draft. Logs distinguish accepted queue from immediate input without content.
